note: DECODED VALUES ONLY -- no raw hex. Cannot be paired with fresh raw hex because counters have moved since 2023. Used to constrain the layout (field widths, sentinel value, ordering), not to solve it.
column_order: Recent, then Lifetime -- confirmed by VCDS label ENG121352: 'Total Distance Traveled (Recent),Total Distance Traveled (Lifetime)'

sentinel.meaning: not available / not supported. At scale 1/10 and 1/100 these are both raw -1, i.e. all bits set.
sentinel.seen_on: every vehicle whose Recent window is unpopulated, and on both columns of a battery-electric vehicle
